test_parameter.name: choice

test_parameter.help: When supplying multiple files, batch mode will run NanoPlot on each file separately, while combined mode will run NanoPlot once on all the reads together. When only supplying a single input file, this setting does not matter.

test_parameter.name: type
test_parameter.label: Type of the file(s) to work on

parameters.name: maxlength
parameters.label: Drop reads longer than length specified.

parameters.name: minlength
parameters.label: Drop reads shorter than length specified.

parameters.name: drop_outliers
parameters.label: Drop outlier reads with extreme long length.

parameters.name: downsample
parameters.label: Reduce dataset to N reads by random sampling.

parameters.name: loglength
parameters.label: Logarithmic scaling of lengths in plots.

parameters.name: percentqual
parameters.label: Use qualities as theoretical percent identities.

parameters.name: alength
parameters.label: Use aligned read lengths rather than sequenced length (bam mode).

parameters.name: minqual
parameters.label: Drop reads with an average quality lower than specified.

parameters.name: runtime_until
parameters.label: Only take the N first hours of a run

parameters.name: readtype
parameters.label: Which read type to extract information about from summary.

parameters.name: barcoded
parameters.label: Use if you want to split the summary file by barcode.

parameters.name: no_supplementary
parameters.label: Use if you want to remove supplementary alignments

parameters.name: color
parameters.label: Specify a color for the plots.

parameters.name: plots
parameters.label: Specify the bivariate format of the plots.

parameters.name: N50
parameters.label: Show the N50 mark in the read length histogram.

help.content:
**What it does**

        NanoPlot_ is a plotting tool for long read sequencing data and alignments written by `Wouter De Coster`_

        .. _NanoPlot: https://github.com/wdecoster/NanoPlot
        .. _`Wouter De Coster`: https://github.com/wdecoster

        **Input**

        NanoPlot requires 1 or more files as input. They can either be fastq (can be generated
        by albacore, guppy or MinKNOW containing additional information), fasta, sorted bam,
        sorted cram or sequencing summary.

        **Output**

        NanoPlot produces different number of plots depending on the data and customizations.
        A detailed view can be seen on here_. Additionally a file showing the statistics
        is generated.

        .. _here: https://github.com/wdecoster/NanoPlot#plots-generated
